P151.s1.text: The thorax and tegulae are yellowish brown.

P151.s2.text: The labial palpi are short, \~ 1.5 × as long as the longitudinal eye diameter, with the third segment acute and framed with brown scales.

P151.s3.text: The antennae are yellow, with only the basal area above the scape adorned with dark-brown scales.

P151.s4.text: The wingspan measures 14 mm, and the wings have a yellowish brown colouration.

P151.s5.text: There is a narrow white band medially on the fore wings (potentially even more bands can be present, but it is difficult to distinguish them clearly on the single available specimen of a mediocre quality), and alternating brown and yellowish portions of scales are present in the distal half of the fore wings.

P151.s6.text: The wings’ basal areas are covered with brown scales.

P151.s7.text: The hind wings are slightly paler than the fore wings, with alternating brown and yellow portions of scales along all lobes.

P151.s8.text: The fringe on all wings is yellow, and the hind wings appear pale-yellow.

P153.s0.text: **Male genitalia.** The uncus is short, widening apically.

P153.s1.text: The gnathos is robust, sharply narrowing apically.

P153.s2.text: The valves are narrow, long, and poorly sclerotised.

P153.s3.text: The gnathos arms are short and narrow-triangular.

P153.s4.text: The anellus arms are thin, long, straight, and apically form axe-shaped extensions.

P153.s6.text: The aedeagus is long, slightly longer than the genital structure, and bears a series of tiny transverse spiky cornuti distally, along with two big needle-like cornuti positioned along the aedeagus medially.
